column3: “Consult with them” replaces letting them inquire of Me.
“Great idolatry” renders the multitude of idols.
Taking the house by its heart becomes taking hold of the people’s hearts.
Cutting off the food supply replaces breaking the staff of bread.
“Their own” is added to sons and daughters.
“Their own” is added to sons and daughters.
Son and daughter are pluralized, with “their own” added.
